assay_run.method: Day-7 ALP staining of SHED receiving piR48444 knockdown or the matched Con reference in Figure 2A. Lentiviral preparation is described in the general Methods, but the exact control construct for this panel is not separately specified. Cells were seeded at 26,000 cells/well in 48-well plates, fixed with paraformaldehyde, and stained using the Beyotime ALP kit (C3206). Staining intensity was quantified using ImageJ. Figure 2A reports three independent experiments. Repository content: study-level source data for the selected paper.
assay_run.platform: Leica stereomicroscope; LAS EZ imaging software
